newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T's Eagle Star to buy New Ireland firm.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T's Eagle Star to buy New Ireland firm.

text.p: B.A.T Industries Plc said on Wednesday that its Eagle Star Insurance Company (Ireland) Ltd has signed an agreement to purchase a New Ireland Holdings Plc firm, Irish National Insurance Company for 30 million punts.
"This acquisition will almost double Eagle Star's general insurance premium income in Ireland and will increase its market share above 10 percent," the company said in a statement.
Eagle Star is funding the acquisition from its resources it had earned from its trade in Ireland.
The joint premium income of Eagle Star and Irish Natioal for the year to December 31, 1995 exceeded 140 million punts. The total number of employees would be around 450.
Irish National reported pre-tax profits of 3.2 million punts in 1995.
Eagle Star said the merger would lead to some job losses but iit expected to tackle it on a voluntary basis.
